reason: My clients already work from their architect's renderings, and I only add a line item if the homeowner agrees to pay for it. I'm not going to eat $1,500 a home on something nobody asked me for.
objection: What happens every time the client changes the plan? At $500 a round I'm either eating that cost or fighting the homeowner over a new line item, and they change plans constantly.
would_change_my_mind: A homeowner who says up front they'll pay for it, or the free sample of one of my real plans looking good and revisions being much cheaper or included until framing.
